movelist.name: Metal Sound
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Special Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Assurance
movelist.effect: When you hit with Assurance, if Assurance’s target has already been damaged by a Move on the same round Assurance is being used, Assurance has a Damage Base of 12 (3d12+10 / 30) instead. This effect may trigger only once per Scene per Target.

movelist.name: Slash
movelist.effect: Slash is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Metal Claw
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage on 18+.

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.effect: The user cannot be Flinched, and their Initiative cannot be unwillingly lowered by any effects.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.effect: The user and all allies within 10 meters may immediately Disengage 1 Meter as a free Action. Rally does not work on sleeping, paralyzed, stuck, fainted, or otherwise incapacitated allies.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Melee Attack
